Title: Token与上下文窗口
Subtitle: Token是处理信息的单位，上下文窗口限定当次可参考的信息范围
Main layout TWO broad explanatory sections, one above another, integrated flat composition.
Upper section heading “Token：文本怎样变成可处理的片段”
Show mixed-language sentence “AI helps 我分析数据。” followed by a clean conceptual strip of six differently shaded blue token tiles:
[AI] [ helps] [ 我] [分析] [数据] [。]
Keep spaces conceptually visible through spacing but do not add arbitrary numeric token IDs. Under the strip this prominent note must be legible:
“概念拆分示意，并非某个分词器的精确输出。”
Supporting text “一个Token可能对应字符、词的一部分或标点，实际拆分取决于分词器。”
Do not label this exact sentence as having6tokens, do not imply one Chinese character or English word always equals one token.
Lower section heading “上下文窗口：当次模型可参考的信息”
A single large outlined horizontal window diagram containing four successive meaningful labeled blue bands “指令与任务”“提供的资料”“对话与工具结果”“输出预留空间”. Size of colored bands is conceptual; no percentage or numeric window limit. Label the overall frame “窗口容量示意”. Show a modest arrow from the window toward “生成回答”.
A short note under it “通常需为输出留出空间，具体限制依模型与平台而异。”
Lower compact real task example:
“行业报告任务：明确问题、选入相关资料、保留关键记录，再生成结论。”
Two concise practical takeaways with fine vertical separators:
“窗口更长 ≠ 信息一定都能有效利用”
“保留重点、清理重复，比一味堆材料更重要”
Bottom bold closing “上下文是当次可见信息，不等于模型永久记住了这些内容。”
Page21. This conceptual page should use explanatory diagrams rather than irrelevant photos. No claims that model learns new permanent weights from normal chat, no token count estimates or fixed context sizes.

“研究员把报告交给导师，因为后者要审核结论。”

Subtitle: 训练学习与调整参数，推理利用已有参数执行当前任务
Main upper two-column comparison, training left, inference right. Each has three aligned semantic rows and a simple process flow, no fake timings or costs.
LEFT heading “训练：让模型学会规律”
“输入” / “训练数据、目标与反馈”
“计算” / “计算误差或奖励，通常更新参数”
“产物” / “训练后的模型参数”
Simple conceptual loop “数据 → 模型计算 → 优化更新 → 参数”, feedback arrow back to model allowed.
RIGHT heading “推理：用模型完成任务”
“输入” / “当前指令、资料与交互记录”
“计算” / “使用已有参数进行预测或生成”
“产物” / “回答、预测或工具调用请求”
Simple flow “请求 → 已训练模型 → 结果”.
A slim precise contrast line across middle “普通对话中的上下文变化，通常不会自动改写模型参数。”
Lower-left a REAL documentary photograph from input2, framed cleanly, approximately x45y740width610height240. Preserve the actual technician and server racks, do not re-create or beautify the person. Caption below “真实机房运维场景，不代表特定模型训练现场”. Do not claim the technician is training an AI model.
Lower-right compact heading “推理开销还受这些因素影响”

“上下文长度” / “需要处理多少输入”
“输出长度” / “需要生成多少内容”
“工具调用” / “是否还要检索、计算或操作”
